handoff: Blocking F1: the ready approval records the local head, now past the PR head (boundaries after open-pr are heads-only), so readyHead never sets ready_head_norn and every approval with the PR open raises a false 'PR head changed after ready approval' Check item. AC1-AC7 are each traced to a test; unit tier and typecheck green.

findings.title: Every ready approval with the PR open now raises a false 'PR head changed after ready approval' Check item
findings.detail:
In the shipped story workflow, open-pr pushes the branch at commit X. The open-pr boundary (done → ci) and the ci boundary (pass → ready) are now heads-only (`commitFor` sets push:false, heads:true, packages/core/src/decide/receipts.ts:155), so the story worktree HEAD is Z, two norn commits past X, and the PR head stays X. `norn story approve` records the worktree HEAD Z as the approve receipt's head_sha (packages/cli/src/commands/story-approve.ts unitHead), which observe turns into ready_head_sha = Z. `readyHead` (packages/cli/src/runtime/observe/remote.ts:33, and the same code in packages/view/src/load.ts:356-358) calls onlyNornCommitsSince(root, Z, X), which requires Z to be an ancestor of X (packages/store/src/git.ts:205). Z is not an ancestor of X, so ready_head_norn stays unset. `headChangedItem` (packages/core/src/inbox/items.ts:771) then sees pr.head_sha X !== ready Z and adds a Check item 'PR #N head changed after ready approval (Z → X)' with the command `git log --stat Z..X`, which lists nothing. Before this change every boundary pushed the branch, so the PR head equalled the approved head. The scenario is exactly the one push-rule.test.ts › 'AC1, AC2, AC3, AC4…' drives (line 171: approve at ready while the remote branch is atOpenPr and head(s) is ahead), but no test looks at the inbox afterwards. The cause is the change in what moves the branch, not the observe code, which this diff does not touch.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Treat a PR head that is an ancestor of the approved head, with only this story's norn commits between them (X..Z), as unchanged. For example, in readyHead also test onlyNornCommitsSince(root, prHead, sha), or record the PR head (the commit the person read) on the approval. Add a test: a ready approval with the PR open and heads-only boundaries after open-pr leaves no head-changed item. A person's push to the branch after the approval must still raise it.
